Working notes — routing tickets

Observed rules from attempts:
- Option C (regional office) was rejected for almost every request: claims/refunds/shipments across south, north, and east; large and small; from Partner Accounts, Field Sales, Client Services, Finance Desk.
- Exception: REQ-2408 was accepted with C. It was a small shipment, north region, and the sender was Regional Ops. This suggests C is valid only when the request originates from Regional Ops, not merely because it mentions a regional office.
- Option B (priority desk) was rejected for large refunds: REQ-2406 (south, Partner Accounts) and REQ-2409 (east, Finance Desk). Avoid B for large refunds unless new evidence supports it.
- Option A (standard queue) has not been tried yet. It is the likely fallback for requests that do not meet a special routing condition.

Practical guidance:
- If sender/requester is Regional Ops, try C first.
- If request is a large refund, do not choose B.
- Do not choose C for Client Services, Field Sales, Partner Accounts, or Finance Desk based on current evidence.
- Region and size alone do not determine routing: C failed for small north claims and small east shipments.
- For other cases, prefer A unless a clear pattern for B emerges. Track outcomes to confirm whether B is valid for large claims/shipments or other priority cases.

Working notes — routing tickets (updated)

Observed:
- C (regional office): only known success is REQ-2408: small shipment, north, Regional Ops. New C failures: REQ-2410 small claim east Regional Ops; REQ-2418 small claim south Regional Ops; REQ-2419 small shipment south Regional Ops. C previously failed across claims/refunds/shipments, regions, and senders. Do not use C merely because sender=Regional Ops or the request mentions a regional office.
- A (standard queue): not a general fallback. Accepted for REQ-2413 (large claim, east, Finance Desk, “through regional office”) and REQ-2415 (large claim, east, Field Sales, same phrase). Rejected for large invoice north Field Sales; large shipment north Finance Desk; large invoice east Field Sales; large shipment south Finance Desk; small shipment east Client Services. So A appears valid for large claims in east, possibly with regional-office phrase, but not invoices/shipments.
- B (priority desk): still no new successes. Previously rejected for large refunds REQ-2406 and REQ-2409. Avoid B for large refunds; B validity for other priority cases remains unknown.

Guidance:
- For small shipment north from Regional Ops, C may work; otherwise avoid C.
- For large claim in east, try A first, especially if “came in through regional office.”
- Do not use A for invoices or shipments; do not use A for small shipments/Client Services based on current evidence.
- For large refunds, avoid B.
- Track outcomes for B and any C success outside small north shipment. Region and size alone are insufficient; request type and origin/route phrase matter.

Working notes — routing tickets (updated)

Observed:
- A: valid for large claims in east, especially “through regional office” (REQ-2413, REQ-2415). Rejected for large claim north (REQ-2429); large invoice north Field Sales; large shipment north Finance Desk; large invoice east Field Sales; large shipment south Finance Desk; small shipment east Client Services. Avoid A for invoices/shipments and non-east large claims.
- B: accepted for small shipment east, sender Regional Ops (REQ-2428). Rejected for large refunds (REQ-2406, REQ-2409); small refund east Regional Ops (REQ-2421); large claim south Field Sales (REQ-2422); large shipment north Finance Desk (REQ-2425); small invoice east Regional Ops (REQ-2427). Avoid B for refunds, invoices, large shipments, large claims. B may work for small shipment east Regional Ops.
- C: only known success is REQ-2408: small shipment, north, Regional Ops. Failures: small claim east/south Regional Ops; small shipment south Regional Ops. Do not use C merely because sender=Regional Ops or request mentions a regional office.
- D: accepted for small invoice east, sender Partner Accounts (REQ-2423). Rejected for large refund north Field Sales (REQ-2424) and large claim south Partner Accounts (REQ-2426). Avoid D for large refunds/claims.

Guidance:
- Large claim east: try A first.
- Small shipment north Regional Ops: C may work.
- Small shipment east Regional Ops: B worked once.
- Small invoice east Partner Accounts: D worked once; not B for small invoice east Regional Ops.
- Avoid A for invoices/shipments and non-east large claims.
- Avoid B for refunds, invoices, large shipments, large claims.
- Avoid C except small shipment north Regional Ops.
- Avoid D for large refunds/claims.
- Track B successes, C successes outside small north shipment, and D outside small invoice east Partner Accounts. Request type, region, size, sender, and phrase all matter.

Working notes — routing tickets (updated)

Observed:

Rejected: large claim north; large invoice north Field Sales; large shipment north Finance Desk; large invoice east Field Sales; large shipment south Finance Desk; small shipment east Client Services; small refund north Partner Accounts (REQ-2436). Avoid A for invoices/shipments, non-east large claims, and at least small refund north Partner Accounts.
- B: works for small shipment east, sender Regional Ops or Partner Accounts (REQ-2428, REQ-2431). Rejected for refunds, invoices, large shipments, large claims, and small claim south Regional Ops (REQ-2439). Avoid B for those; try B for small shipment east.
- C: only known success: small shipment north Regional Ops (REQ-2408). Rejected: small claim east/south Regional Ops; small shipment south Regional Ops; large claim north Finance Desk (REQ-2432). Avoid C except small shipment north Regional Ops.
- D: works for invoice east: small Partner Accounts (REQ-2423), large Field Sales (REQ-2437). Rejected: large refund north Field Sales; large claim south Partner Accounts; large invoice north Field Sales; small invoice north Client Services; large invoice south Finance Desk; small invoice south Regional Ops. Avoid D for invoices outside east and large refunds/claims.

Guidance:
- Large claim east: A first.
- Small claim south Regional Ops: A worked; B rejected.
- Small shipment east: B worked with Regional Ops/Partner Accounts.
- Small shipment north Regional Ops: C may work.
- Invoice east: D may work (small Partner Accounts, large Field Sales).
- Avoid A for invoices/shipments, non-east large claims, small refund north Partner Accounts.
- Avoid B for refunds, invoices, large shipments, large claims, small claim south.
- Avoid C except small shipment north Regional Ops.
- Avoid D for invoices outside east and large refunds/claims.
- Track B successes, C successes outside small north shipment, D outside east invoices. Type, region, size, sender, phrase matter.

- B works: small shipment east with Regional Ops, Partner Accounts, or Client Services. Rejected: refunds, invoices, large shipments, large claims, small claim south Regional Ops, small shipment south Partner Accounts (REQ-2443). Avoid B for those; try B for small shipment east only.

Working notes — routing tickets

Observed rules:
A:
- Works: large claim east; small claim east Regional Ops; small claim south Regional Ops; large claim south Field Sales/Partner Accounts.
- Rejected: large claim north; invoices; shipments incl. large shipment east; refunds.
- Use A for large claim east/south, small claim east/south Regional Ops.

B:
- Works: small shipment east with Regional Ops/Partner Accounts/Client Services.
- Rejected: refunds, invoices, large shipments/claims, small claim south Regional Ops, small shipment south Partner Accounts.
- Use B only for small shipment east.

C:
- Works: only small shipment north Regional Ops.
- Rejected: small claim east/south Regional Ops; small shipment south Regional Ops; large claim north Finance Desk; invoices incl. large invoice south Finance Desk/Field Sales; large shipment north Partner Accounts; large refund south.
- Avoid C except small shipment north Regional Ops.

D:
- Works: small invoice east Partner Accounts; large invoice east Field Sales; large claim north Field Sales.
- Rejected: refunds incl. large refund south; large claim south Partner Accounts; invoices outside east incl. small invoice north, large invoice north Partner Accounts/Field Sales; large shipment east/north Finance Desk; large invoice east Partner Accounts/Finance Desk.
- Use D only for east invoices as above or large claim north Field Sales.

Guidance:
- Large claim east: A. Large claim south: A. Large claim north Field Sales: D.
- Small claim east/south Regional Ops: A.
- Refunds: avoid A/C/D in tested cases; no valid desk found.
- Invoice east: D for small Partner Accounts or large Field Sales; not large Partner Accounts/Finance Desk. Invoices outside east: avoid A/C/D from tests; unknown.
- Shipment: small east B; small north Regional Ops C; avoid A/D/C for large shipments tested.
- Track type, region, size, sender, phrase.

Working notes — routing tickets

Observed:
A works: large claim east/south (incl. Field Sales); small claim east/south Regional Ops.
A rejected: large claim north; invoices; shipments incl. large shipment east; small shipment south Regional Ops; small claim north Regional Ops. Use A only as above.

B works: small shipment east (Regional Ops/Partner Accounts/Client Services tested; Partner Accounts accepted).
B rejected: refunds; invoices; large shipments/claims; small claim south Regional Ops; small shipment south Partner Accounts/Client Services. Use B only for small shipment east.

C works: small shipment north Regional Ops.
C rejected: small claim east/south Regional Ops; small shipment south Regional Ops; large claim north Finance Desk; invoices incl. large invoice south Finance Desk/Field Sales, large invoice east Finance Desk; large shipment north Partner Accounts; large refund south. Avoid C except small shipment north Regional Ops.

D works: small invoice east Partner Accounts; large claim north Field Sales.
D rejected: refunds incl. large refund south; large claim south Partner Accounts; invoices outside east incl. small/large north; large shipment east/north Finance Desk; large invoice east Partner Accounts/Finance Desk; small invoice east Regional Ops; large invoice east Field Sales. Use D only for small invoice east Partner Accounts or large claim north Field Sales.

Guidance:
- Claims: large east/south A; large north Field Sales D; small east/south Regional Ops A. Small claim north Regional Ops A rejected.
- Invoices: east—small Partner Accounts D works; small Regional Ops D rejected; large Field Sales D rejected; large Finance Desk C rejected. Outside east avoid A/C/D; unknown.
- Refunds: no valid desk found; avoid A/C/D in tested cases.
- Shipments: small east B; small north Regional Ops C; small south A/B rejected; large shipments avoid A/D/C tested.
- Track type, region, size, sender, phrase.
